title: Understanding the Model
text: The model Shreya uses is given by the equation: $$hat{y}=\theta_2 \theta_1 x$$. This is a simple linear model where hat{y} is the predicted value.

title: Loss Function Explanation
text: The loss function is defined as L(hat{y},y)=hat{y}-theta_2*y. This function measures the difference between the predicted value hat{y} and the scaled actual value $$\theta_2 y$$.

title: Gradient Descent Step
text: To perform one iteration of stochastic gradient descent, we need to compute the gradient of the loss function with respect to $$\theta_1$$ and update $$\theta_1$$ using the learning rate alpha.

title: Compute the Gradient
text: Calculate the gradient of the loss function with respect to $$\theta_1$$. Use the given values: theta_1**{(t)}=3, theta_2**{(t)}=pi, $$(x,y)=(2,1)$$.

title: Update $$\theta_1$$
text: Use the gradient and the learning rate $$alpha=0.5$$ to update $$\theta_1$$. The update rule is: theta_1**{(t+1)}=theta_1**{(t)}-alpha*gradient.
